# Use OIDC

## Summary

This section covers how to enable and manage OpenID Connect (OIDC) for single sign-on (SSO).

**Source**: https://docs.n8n.io/administer/manage-users-and-access/verify-user-identity/use-oidc.md

---

{% hint style="info" %}
**Feature availability**

* Available on Enterprise plans.
* You need to be an instance owner or admin to enable and configure OIDC.
  {% endhint %}

This section covers how to enable and manage OpenID Connect (OIDC) for single sign-on (SSO). You can learn more about how OIDC works by visiting [what is OpenID Connect](https://openid.net/developers/how-connect-works/) by the OpenID Foundation.

## In this section

* [Set up OIDC](/administer/manage-users-and-access/verify-user-identity/use-oidc/set-up-oidc): a general guide to setting up OpenID Connect (OIDC) SSO in n8n.
* [Troubleshooting](/administer/manage-users-and-access/verify-user-identity/use-oidc/troubleshoot-oidc): a list of things to check if you encounter issues with OIDC.
